criterion: CRIT-004 (process note, not a code defect)
title: CRIT-004's Tier-3 live re-attack, run by this adversary, wrote into the SHARED gig-board witness state file (not a dedicated test path) and replaced two pre-existing 2026-07-06 gigs
description: The adversary sourced ~/.anicca-signing/gig-board/.env (as scripts/e2e-testnet.mjs's own README instructs) before running scripts/e2e-testnet.mjs for the mandatory Tier-3 re-attack. That .env sets GIG_STATE_PATH=/Users/anicca/.anicca-signing/gig-board/state/gigs.json -- the SAME shared path WITNESS-RUNBOOK.md documents as holding the 2026-07-06 e2e-testnet.mjs run's gigs #1/#2 (tx 0x06584e56a45d537321820a6e070afae04fdbe360c7586c72a6dbd61e243573e7 and 0x89aff87c5eadba9eebc035341210a87cdc9d0a3d993308ddd2a30eca1c2b3491, per the facilitator's own append-only log). The adversary did not snapshot the file's prior content before running. After the adversary's run, gigs.json contains exactly 2 gigs, both IDed '1'/'2' with the adversary's OWN fresh 2026-07-07 tx hashes (0x0f9c5a29f0c97614e22fd706bab7244497aaa7e262e99fbdc3485c4939b6de18 / 0xad859b1bbdde2dd26133e89d60c42876d531a24194beb35cb276114d1e4d010e / 0xeaee56c2256a133bd2e655af168c0c570f4b696a85911a7931c447faa443a067 / 0x0bea7addb8d1cc72798b2db17c73469fc3eea3b9a94bb63c823b2cf06cf03ba7) -- meaning nextId had already reset to 1 by the time the adversary's script ran (a fresh gigPost cannot otherwise produce id '1'/'2' if the file already held a nextId of 3). The adversary cannot determine with certainty, after the fact, whether its own run caused this reset or whether the file was already reset by other activity earlier on 2026-07-07 before this review began. Separately, and unrelated to the reset question: gig-board/.env's GIG_CHAIN is currently 'base' (mainnet) and GIG_FACILITATOR_URL currently points at :8407, not the :8405 testnet facilitator scripts/e2e-testnet.mjs's own README documents sourcing this same .env file for -- running the documented command verbatim (without the adversary's explicit GIG_CHAIN=base-sepolia / GIG_FACILITATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8405 override) fails outright with 'gas required exceeds allowance (0)' because the poster/taker test wallets hold Base Sepolia testnet ETH, not Base mainnet ETH.
impact: No fund-safety or code-correctness impact: this is a state-file/environment-configuration side effect of exercising the mandatory Tier-3 obligation, not a defect in lock.mjs/gig.mjs/catalog-gate.mjs. The underlying evidentiary trail for the ORIGINAL 2026-07-06 gigs is not fully lost -- the facilitator's own append-only log (~/anicca/.worktrees/agent-economy/services/facilitator/state/facilitator.log) still contains both the original 2026-07-06 settle tx hashes AND the adversary's new 2026-07-07 ones in one continuous, unedited file -- but the gigs.json JSON snapshot WITNESS-RUNBOOK.md's prose describes no longer contains those original 2 records.
recommendation: Future Tier-3 live re-attacks (this sprint's own or any later one) should override GIG_STATE_PATH to a dedicated, disposable test-only path (e.g. a fresh mktemp file) rather than inheriting the shared gig-board/.env's GIG_STATE_PATH, so the shared witness board's own history is never at risk of being overwritten by an adversary's re-verification run. Separately, scripts/e2e-testnet.mjs's README usage instructions ('source ~/.anicca-signing/gig-board/.env') should be updated to note that this file now defaults to GIG_CHAIN=base/mainnet (per the 2026-07-07 witness-setup) and that a testnet re-run requires an explicit GIG_CHAIN=base-sepolia + GIG_FACILITATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8405 override, or the documented command fails with a confusing 'gas required exceeds allowance (0)' error that looks like an insufficient-balance bug but is actually a wrong-network mismatch (poster/taker wallets hold zero Base mainnet ETH).

evidence.description: Post-run content: nextId=3, gigs '1'/'2' both dated 2026-07-07 with the adversary's own tx hashes.

Continuous log confirms both the original 2026-07-06T18:50Z settles (tx 0x06584e56..., 0x89aff87c...) and the adversary's 2026-07-07T06:19-06:20Z settles (tx 0x0f9c5a29..., 0xad859b1b..., 0xeaee56c2..., 0x0bea7add...) in the same unedited file.
Documents the original 2026-07-06 gigs #1/#2 the adversary's run has since numerically overwritten in the JSON snapshot (though not in the facilitator's own log).
